bssn.description: Led two concurrent security projects a secure Android key-entry app and a malware analysis sandbox coordinating a 3-person dev team across planning, development, and system integration.
achievements: Developed a Flutter/Dart Android app with secure login, user profile management, and cryptographic key-entry compliant with EAL 3 standards; all user data encrypted and user-key-protected.
Built an Automatic Malware Analyzer integrating Nginx, Docker, Python, MISP, VirusTotal, and Arkime; accurately detected WannaCry with a malscore of 10/10 while scoring benign files at 0-1/10.
Defined acceptance criteria aligned with Common Criteria and applied security-by-design across the SDLC covering access control, data flow hardening, and application hardening.
Managed team workflow via GitHub (branching, PRs, code reviews) and documented system architecture in Miro.

komanstra.title: Secure Key-Entry App
komanstra.subtitle: Hardware-Integrated Cryptographic Security App
komanstra.fullDesc: Secure Ht Box is a high-security Android-based (cross-platform) mobile application developed using the Flutter framework. This application is specifically designed as a secure interface for managing, injecting, and synchronizing cryptographic data/keys to external hardware (STM32 microcontrollers) directly via USB Serial communication.

analyzer.title: Automatic Malware Analyzer
analyzer.subtitle: Security Sandbox Platform
analyzer.fullDesc: Automatic Malware Analyzer is an advanced automated malware analysis platform designed for in-depth extraction, behavioral classification, and threat identification within a sandboxed environment. It is built to dynamically analyze suspicious files and links, integrating layered virtualization with a threat intelligence management system to generate accurate Indicators of Compromise (IoC).

yogtrip.title: YogTrip
yogtrip.subtitle: Yogyakarta Travel Recommendation System
yogtrip.fullDesc: A hybrid recommendation system based on Knowledge Graph and Path Ranking Algorithm (PRA). Integrating MySQL and Neo4j for graph data modeling and personalized travel recommendations.

localine.title: LOCALINE
localine.subtitle: Web System Development (Union in Technology)
localine.fullDesc: A React-based web platform to support UMKM digitalization and expand market access. Produced a competition-ready product that won third place at IT Days 2024.
